title: Matrix LR down-sweep (MATRIX_LR 0.04 -> 0.03)
description: Decreased MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.03 (25% lower Muon LR), all else unchanged from DEPTH=10 baseline.
reflection: val_bpb 1.005562, worse than baseline 1.002279 by roughly the same margin as round 2's increase to 0.05 (~1.0058-1.0060). MATRIX_LR=0.04 is now bracketed on both sides and confirmed as a tight local optimum -- no further single-scalar LR-magnitude sweeps on this axis are worth running. Future rounds should try a genuinely untested axis (e.g. WINDOW_PATTERN, HEAD_DIM, or TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE) rather than more perturbations near the current baseline.
